basis: NBA players returned an average of 372.5 days after ACL reconstruction (26 players, 84% returned). No spread reported, so the fast end is 80% of the average.

NBA players returned an average of 311 days (SD 101) after surgical repair of a complete Achilles rupture (25 players, 1996-2017; 80% returned). Fast end = average minus one SD. A larger study found 72% returned, after 11.2 months on average.
NBA players who had surgery for shoulder instability returned after an average of 19 weeks (50 players). No spread reported, so the fast end is 80% of the average.
NBA players missed a median of 17 games (about 5 weeks) after surgery for an isolated meniscus tear (47 players, 2010-2023; 91% returned). Fast end is 80% of that; the median is the latest return.

NBA players returned an average of 9.8 weeks after surgery for a Jones (fifth metatarsal) fracture (10 players). Fast end is 80% of the average; the average is the latest return. Applied to foot fractures only.
